newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia CPI up 4.2 in May from previous month.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia CPI up 4.2 in May from previous month.

text.p: Mongolia's consumer price index increased by 4.2 percent in May compared with April, central bank figures showed on Monday.
That compared with an increase of 5.8 percent in April against March, the Bank of Mongolia's Monthly Statistical Bulletin said.

The change from the beginning of the year was 19.1 percent. The bulletin gave no annual CPI figure saying it was impossible to calculate because the CPI basket used by the State Statistical Office had been changed since January.
